proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13161 saptāha means a period of seven days and gives Nepali sātā “week”. Rajasthani sapta/sapto preserve learned pt with regional final adaptation; this family link leaves learned or neighboring Indo-Aryan transmission open.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11392 varṣa section 2 lists Hindi baras and Old Marwari barasa “year”. The rain responses barkha require varṣā or a different extension; they are not automatically treated as this bare head.
